QuestInfo.name: The Gullible Boogies
QuestInfo.0: Dances with Balrog has a message for 10 Boogies.
QuestInfo.1: Dances with Balrog wants you to thank 10 Boogies for the gift, without mentioning what happened. Still, you feel like you should explain Blackbull's trick...
QuestInfo.2: 10 Boogies believes that Blackbull is a good man. Guess there's no helping some people.

0.0: In any event, could you tell 10 Boogies I said thank you?

yes.0: Just tell 10 Boogies I said thank you. Don't mention the monsters in it.

no.0: If you are really so busy, fine. Return when you have time.

1.0: Hey! Did you give my gift to Dances with Balrog? Did he like it? He liked it, right?\r\n#L0##bDances with Balrog didn't want me to tell you, but I must be honest...that box was full of monsters! Was that your doing?#l\n#k
1.1: Monsters? That is so weird. Blackbull said there was a nice sword inside...\r\n#L0##bWell, he must have tricked you.#l\n#k
1.2: Oh, no! Blackbull would never do that. He's so nice to me! Like, one time, he gave me a pet snake. He left it in my bed to find, too. Like a surprise present! Anyway, there's something else I need help with, if you have time.

yes.0: Hey, can you come back in a minute? I lost my notes on what to say next...

npc.0: You have not delivered my message to 10 Boogies yet. Take your time...and don't mention the monsters.
